label: Adverbs of Time
description: A 20-question check on time and frequency adverbs.

questions.prompt: What does «уже» mean in «Я уже сделал домашнее задание»?
questions.explain: With a perfective past verb «уже» means already, marking the homework as finished.

questions.prompt: In «Он ещё спит», what does «ещё» mean?
questions.explain: With a present-tense verb «ещё» means still, signalling that the sleeping is ongoing.

questions.prompt: How would you say 'always' in Russian?
questions.explain: «Всегда» means always, as in «Я всегда пью кофе утром».

questions.prompt: What does «иногда» mean in «Иногда я гуляю по вечерам»?
questions.explain: «Иногда» means sometimes, marking an action that happens now and then.

questions.prompt: Which time adverb best fills the blank in «Я ___ хожу в библиотеку», meaning 'I often go to the library'?
questions.explain: «Часто» means often and modifies «хожу» to say how regularly the trip happens.

questions.prompt: How would you say 'tomorrow' in Russian?
questions.explain: «Завтра» means tomorrow, as in «Завтра у нас важный экзамен».

questions.prompt: What does the sentence «Наконец ты пришёл домой!» say in English?
questions.explain: «Наконец» means finally or at last, expressing relief that he has come home.

questions.prompt: In the pair «Сначала поедим, потом погуляем», what does «потом» mark?
options: the first step in a sequence
questions.explain: Paired with «сначала», «потом» marks the second step — what happens afterwards.

questions.prompt: What does «обычно» mean in «Обычно я встаю в семь утра»?
questions.explain: «Обычно» means usually, framing getting up at seven as the normal routine.

questions.prompt: How would you say 'recently' in Russian?
questions.explain: «Недавно» means recently, as in «Я недавно прочитал интересную книгу».

questions.prompt: What does «давно» mean in «Я давно тебя не видел»?
questions.explain: «Давно» means for a long time, stressing how long it has been since they met.

questions.prompt: In «Раньше он курил, а теперь нет», what does «теперь» express?
options: now, after a change from before
questions.explain: Paired with «раньше», «теперь» means now and completes a before-and-after contrast.

questions.prompt: Which time adverb best fits «___ начнётся фильм», meaning 'The film will start soon'?
questions.explain: «Скоро» means soon and points to a near-future start of the film.

questions.prompt: What does «сразу» mean in «Я сразу понял свою ошибку»?
questions.explain: «Сразу» means right away or at once, marking instant understanding of the mistake.

questions.prompt: What does the sentence «Ты опять опоздал на урок!» say in English?
options: You were late for class again!
You are never late for class!
You are always early for class!
You will be late for class soon!
questions.explain: «Опять» means again, marking a repeated lateness with a note of reproach.

questions.prompt: What does «впервые» mean in «Я впервые увидел море»?
questions.explain: «Впервые» means for the first time, marking a first-ever experience of the sea.

questions.prompt: Both «уже» and «ещё» can appear in questions. Which is the standard way to ask 'Is the shop still open?'
questions.explain: «Ещё» asks whether a state has not yet ended, so «Магазин ещё открыт?» means still open.

questions.prompt: Which time adverb best fills the blank in «Однажды я встретил старого друга», meaning 'one day / once'?
questions.explain: «Однажды» means once or one day, opening a single past event like a story.

questions.prompt: In the sequence «Сначала позавтракай, затем иди гулять», what does «затем» mean?
questions.explain: «Затем» means then or after that, ordering the second action after breakfast.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT a time or frequency adverb?
questions.explain: «Медленно» means slowly (a manner adverb); the others — always, sometimes, often — are time/frequency adverbs.
